data.revised_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop web application visual design concept, 1440px wide
Primary request: high-fidelity HTML product UI mockup for a multi-site SEO operations platform, Website Projects overview screen.
Scene/backdrop: modern desktop browser viewport, no device frame
Subject: a dark graphite left sidebar with three navigation items, a compact top project context bar, and a spacious pale cool-gray content canvas. Main area shows a strong page title, an inline create-website row, and varied website project cards with domain, industry, country, keyword/title/content/knowledge counts, real task status and clear enter-project action.
Style/medium: real production web UI, precise HTML/CSS layout, editorial product design, dense but calm, no illustration, no 3D render.
Composition/framing: 16:10 full desktop dashboard screenshot, clear 8px spacing system, asymmetric but balanced grid.
Color palette: charcoal #121a23 navigation, cool gray canvas, white panels, deep teal primary actions, one restrained copper status accent.
Text (verbatim): "Website Projects" "Create website" "Enter project" "Keywords" "Titles" "Content" "Knowledge base"
Constraints: crisp readable English UI labels only, realistic tables/cards/forms, accessibility-first contrast, no logos, no browser chrome, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no generic AI sparkles, no watermark.
Avoid: landing page hero, decorative illustration, random charts, garbled text, purple-blue palette, rounded balloon cards.
